what: Idle motion of a hand-drawn character sitting on a line. Like a GIF that snaps frame to frame with no in-betweens (steps), the pupils roll center → left (16%) → right (38%) → up (56%) → center (72%), and the eyes close for about .14s at 86% (4.8s loop). Two sets of legs switch on alternately every .48s to make it walk, and the tail swings 0 → 9° → −6°.

options.--fx-dur: One loop (via style), default 4.8s — original GIF 3.8·4.32·4.44·4.68·4.8·4.88·5·5.84·6.6s
options.--fx-delay: Offset (set via style), default 0s — keeps several eyes from rolling at the same tempo
options.--fx-look: Range the pupil moves (multiple of pupil diameter, via style), default .42
options.--fx-tail-origin: Axis the tail rotates around (via style), default 0% 100%
options.[data-fx-part=leg-a] / [data-fx-part=leg: Two sets of legs to toggle alternately (optional)
options.[data-fx-part=tail]: Wagging tail path (optional) — drawn as a line (stroke: currentColor)

note: The original is several transparent GIFs (people · cats · books · lumps) — the same tempo is applied in CSS to newly drawn SVG characters. The artwork belongs to whoever attaches it
